verdict.rationale: The fido2-manage tool explicitly supports SSH security keys (generate, list resident, download, upload via ssh-copy-id, add to local ssh-agent), giving hardware-backed FIDO2 sk-ssh keys with touch confirmation, and Token2 also ships PIV management via the miniDriver/Companion App for smartcard-based login. However, there is no evidence of OpenPGP-based SSH key support, and the SSH-key features are only demonstrated in a third-party open-source GUI tool rather than deeply documented first-party guidance. missing for 10: OpenPGP SSH key support, first-party documentation/tutorial specifically for sk-ssh with servers, independent hands-on corroboration of ssh-agent workflow.
